sentences.text:
The present writ petition has been filed for issuance of direction upon the concerned respondents to pay compensation amount of Rs.10,73,600/- to the petitioner in lieu of acquisition of house constructed on plot no. 143, Khata No. 04, Mouza- Amarpur, Thana No. 120, District- Deoghar as well as to reassess the compensation amount by taking note of tube well and puffed rice mill situated on the aforesaid land which was not assessed by the District Land Acquisition Officer,
Deoghar (the respondent no.3).
2. A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the respondent nos. 2 and 3 stating that as per the award prepared in L.A. Case No. 176/2020-21, petitioner's name finds place at serial no. 21 (wrongly mentioned as serial no. 20 in the counter affidavit).

However, despite service of personal notice, she did not choose to receive compensation amount, due to which the respondent no. 3 referred the matter under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (in short, "the Act, 2013") to the concerned Authority i.e.
the court of Principal District Judge, Dumka.
3.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that pursuant to preparation of the award, the matter has been referred to the concerned Authority for adjudication, the aforesaid prayer of the petitioner cannot be considered under extraordinary writ jurisdiction of this Court.
The writ petition is accordingly dismissed.
The petitioner, is, however at liberty to pursue the case before the concerned Authority.
